description: This file implements a logger for Google Cloud Pub/Sub integration within the LiteLLM project. It handles batching and publishing of spend logs and other payloads to GCS Pub/Sub, including HTTP request construction, batch management, and message encoding.

classes.name: GcsPubSubLogger
classes.description: A logger class for sending payload logs asynchronously to Google Cloud Pub/Sub, utilizing batching, asynchronous HTTP requests, and optional authentication.

methods.name: __init__( self, project_id: Optional[str] = None, topic_id: Optional[str] = None, credentials_path: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Initializes the GcsPubSubLogger with project and topic IDs, credentials, and sets up async client and batching.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] construct_request_headers(self)
methods.description: Creates authorization headers for requests using Google Cloud credentials, asynchronously.

methods.name: async_log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Receives event details and payload, appends to batch, and triggers sending when batch size is met.

methods.name: async_send_batch(self)
methods.description: Sends the accumulated batch of messages to Pub/Sub and clears the queue.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] publish_message( self, message: Union[SpendLogsPayload, StandardLoggingPayload] )
methods.description: Encodes and publishes a single message payload to the specified Pub/Sub topic via HTTP.
